facts.text: I returned from a trip to Hawaii today.
I am inspired to dive back into music production on Ableton Live.
I am looking for music production tutorials online.
I am interested in producing a fusion of rock and jazz.
I have been listening to a lot of jazz lately.

I have been trying to capture spontaneity in my own music production.

I have been experimenting with more relaxed drum patterns to capture a laid-back feel.
